models.provenance: official repository metadata captured before inference; different model size from previous 7B trial
same fixed official bytes retained from prior trial; same four authored tasks, new factorial protocol

information_matching: Same specification, full starting files, public examples, compiler/VM/native feedback and hidden oracle for both interfaces. Each response is based on the immutable starting files; no query-only context advantage.
response_decoder: Identical generic JSON-object grammar for all four cells; no solution, file name, AST opcode or field-value constraints in decoder.
patch_semantics: At most 16 ordered exact-string edits against immutable starting files; each old string must be nonempty and match exactly once; no path discovery, fuzzy matching or implicit repair.
hidden_policy: Run once after first public acceptance; terminal even on hidden failure; never returned to model.
task_origin: Unchanged four authored two-file scalar maintenance/upgrade tasks inherited from assembly-v4. They are not an external real-world maintenance corpus or unseen project sample.
cost_scope: Retain every request/response and failed edit, exact reported tokens, build/public/hidden checks, model identity/startup/shutdown and observed preparation/cohort wall time. Historical artifact acquisition and human labor are not measured here.
inference_timeout_policy: Retain every known token count from the exact engine attempt receipt, keep unobserved usage null, terminate the owned model, and restart before the next distinct cell. No same-cell retry after timeout; cleanup/identity failure terminates the cohort.
scope: Prospective full 2x2 factorial engineering pilot; descriptive evidence only.
runtime_identity_policy: Freeze the complete engine runtime_files inventory (binary and sibling .so/.dll files) before capacity checks; reject content, addition, deletion or session-snapshot drift through prepare/run/shutdown. System libraries and hardware remain trusted.
failure_accounting: Persist partial CELL and attempt receipts even on infrastructure/identity failure; charge incurred cell wall and known tokens to its original arm. Unknown token totals stay null. Cleanup failure preserves RESULT and the complete expected denominator, with completed false.
